mapper.select: SELECT r.receipt_id, r.receipt_no, r.doc_id, r.doc_type, DATE_FORMAT(r.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS order_date, r.partner_name, r.requester_id, r.approver_id, r.total_amount, r.status, COALESCE( r.confirmed_no, CASE WHEN r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND r.receipt_no LIKE 'OCR-%' THEN CONCAT('OCR-CONF-', DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '-', r.receipt_id) ELSE NULL END ) AS confirmed_no, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at, req.name AS requester_name, apr.name AS approver_name, d.doc_no FROM order_receipt r LEFT JOIN member req ON r.requester_id = req.member_id LEFT JOIN member apr ON r.approver_id = apr.member_id LEFT JOIN approval_doc d ON r.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE r.receipt_id = #{receiptId}
SELECT item_id, receipt_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, unit, qty, unit_cost, amount FROM order_receipt_item WHERE receipt_id = #{receiptId} ORDER BY item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_receipt (receipt_no, doc_id, doc_type, order_date, partner_name, requester_id, approver_id, total_amount, status, created_at) VALUES (#{receiptNo}, #{docId}, #{docType}, NOW(), #{partnerName}, #{requesterId}, #{approverId}, #{totalAmount}, 'PENDING', NOW())

INSERT INTO order_receipt_item (receipt_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, unit, qty, unit_cost, amount) VALUES (#{receiptId}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{unit}, #{qty}, #{unitCost}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_receipt WHERE doc_id = #{docId}

SELECT r.receipt_id, r.receipt_no, r.doc_id, r.doc_type, DATE_FORMAT(r.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS order_date, r.partner_name, r.requester_id, r.approver_id, r.total_amount, r.status, r.confirmed_no, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at, req.name AS requester_name FROM order_receipt r LEFT JOIN member req ON r.requester_id = req.member_id WHERE r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.receipt_no LIKE 'OCR-%' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE order_receipt_item SET product_id = #{productId}, product_code = #{productCode}, product_name = #{productName}, unit = #{unit}, qty = #{qty}, unit_cost = #{unitCost}, amount = #{amount} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
